name: imagination
description: IMG — a local AI studio for generating images, videos and character-consistent content across multiple AI providers.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
